title.narrative: DCM Ping An Leasing Sustainability Bond

description.narrative:
Stakeholders Effect - Increased access to climate finance: The project is expected to help increase the funding for Ping An Leasing to expand its climate finance portfolio, mainly in clean transportation.
While IFCs investment focuses on climate finance, the proceeds of the bond subscribed by other investors will help increase the funding for Ping An Leasing to expand its SME finance portfolio in China, with a focus on frontier regions and WSMEs.
Market Creation - Sustainability: The Project aims to further nurture a credible market for sustainable finance in the country, through IFCs investment in a publicly offered sustainability bond issued by a local financial institution (FI) in line with international standards. IFC anticipates the issuance of a sustainability bond aligned with international standards by a leasing company will enable other players in the market to follow suit with the issuance of sustainability bonds that meet internationally recognized standards, raising funds for climate and social projects and helping to deepen the market for sustainable finance in China.

The proposed investment entails a subscription of up to 1.8 billion Chinese renminbi (approximately US$250 million equivalent) in an up to 5-year senior bond (the Bond) to be issued by Ping An International Financial Leasing Co., Ltd. (Ping An Leasing or the Company), a commercial leasing company wholly-owned by Ping An Insurance (Group) Company of China, Ltd. (Ping An Group) (2318.HK, 601318.CH) in China. IFC will be an anchor investor in the Bond. The Bond will support Ping An Leasing to expand its eligible climate finance and social finance portfolio in line with the Sustainability Bond Guidelines (and in accordance with the Social Bond Principles and Green Bond Principles) of the International Capital Market Association (ICMA). All of IFC own account investment is expected to be used for eligible climate finance projects. On a best-effort basis, at least 25 percent of the IFCs subscription will be used towards eligible electric vehicle leases for women customers.
